source: LQ-20261107-2148 (Home v010 APPROVED 2026-11-11; HOME-BACKEND-SPEC-20261111 section LQ-2148). Read by scripts/lib/lane_health.py; an unreadable file falls back to the module DEFAULTS and the snapshot names the gap.

notes.late_grace_minutes: spec test: a slot done 20 min late with a 10-min grace is late 1. Lateness is started_at - slot; the slot is matched on the dispatch (requested_at).
notes.stale_after_slots: output signal older than the lane's 3rd-newest expected slot (about 2.5x cadence, the spec's freshness-contract multiple), counted on the lane's own market-day/active-day slots so a weekend is not stale.
notes.business_critical_value_classes: empty = every lane counts toward the Schedulers WARN. LQ-2149 (home_status_registry) decides which lanes are business-critical; set the value classes here when it lands.
notes.unknown_states: NOT_MEASURED (cron/systemd: no per-run ledger, spec A4) keeps the rollup UNKNOWN rather than OK until those lanes move to n8n. Unknown never reads as OK.
notes.stale_after_minutes: the snapshot is stale for a reader after 30 min (3 missed 10-minute slots)
